messages:
ops_ryan: FYI vendor email — shipment ETA slipped. They pushed the wave to Tue 2025-04-08. Proposing to batch replacements into two waves (priority air + bulk sea). Need direction on air vs sea for priority units, and how we split insurance. This affects eu-west-1 H100 pool.

maria_prod: How many units are we talking about and which SKUs? rough cost delta on air?

vendor_lisa: We have 24 units total: 10 H100-priority, 14 H100-backfill. Airbridge for first wave (8–10 units) is available but +$1.2k/unit surcharge and expedited customs handling. Sea for bulk — no surcharge but 6–8 days extra. Insurance: vendor asks for 50/50; they can cover full freight if we take surcharge.

kevin_sre: Cluster note: we've already reduced some capacity in eu-west-1 because of two degraded hosts. If only 8 arrive early, we need to decide which nodes get replaced first. Also confirm depot cross-dock capacity — can handle 10 incoming units on weekday window?

logistics-bot: manifest uploaded: https://shipments.vendorco.com/manifest/AB1234 — AWB preview attached.

maria_prod: Ops, I'm inclined to air 8 for immediate replace and sea the rest. We should prioritize nodes that host latency-critical routes. Surcharge is painful but avoids customer impact. Can we absorb $9.6k extra this month?

anne_finance: 9.6k is doable if we flag as emergency procurement. Need PO amendment + updated invoice terms. 30/70 insurance split (vendor 30%, us 70%) ok? We should not fully underwrite vendor claims.

ops_ryan: vendor_lisa — can you confirm AWB + expected customs ETA and whether they can prepay duties for the air shipment? Also we need explicit RMA label inclusion for returns and a 7-day return booking SLA.

vendor_lisa: Confirmed: AWB AB1234-01 for first 8 units, docs will include RMA return labels and photo checklist. We can prepay duties for air at +$450 flat. Return window 7 days after delivery; pictures mandatory for DOA claims.

kevin_sre: Please add this to the node replacement runbook: mark eu-west-1 nodes N1..N8 as replacement-priority, schedule cordon/drain in 2-hour maintenance windows. If only partial arrives, we'll stage replacements to avoid overloading the depot.

maria_prod: ok proceeding: authorize air for 8 units, sea for 16 (14 backfill + 2 buffer). anne_finance to amend PO and confirm the 30/70 insurance split and duty prepay. ops_ryan can you open a surge budget ticket and confirm the maintenance windows with SRE?

ops_ryan: Opening surge-budget ticket now. Scheduling with SRE for two 2-hr windows tomorrow and day after. Also creating a small canary: drain 2 nodes first to validate replacements and power/cooling at depot.

vendor_lisa: Copy — we'll update manifest with AWB + customs docs by EOD and email the amended invoice when PO is updated. RMA labels will be in the crate.

maria_prod: Thanks team. Quick checklist: 1) PO amendment (anne_finance) 2) AWB + docs (vendor_lisa) 3) Surge budget ticket (ops_ryan) 4) Node cordon schedule (kevin_sre) 5) Can confirm RMA photo checklist and 7-day booking (vendor_lisa). Please reply with "ack" when done. :thumbsup:

anne_finance: ack — starting PO amend now.

kevin_sre: ack — will post node schedule in #eng-sre and link here.

ops_ryan: ack — surge ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4521

vendor_lisa: ack — will push docs + AWB link into this thread when live.

maria_prod: Great. Closing this thread once we have AWB + PO.
